cmdString:
set -e
printf 'CONFIG\n'
uname -a
lscpu
free -m
df -h / /var/lib/artifact-threefold
printf 'LOAD\n'
uptime
vmstat 1 4
printf 'SERVICE\n'
sudo systemctl show artifact-threefold -p MainPID -p MemoryCurrent -p CPUUsageNSec -p TasksCurrent -p LimitNOFILE -p ControlGroup
ps -eo pid,comm,%cpu,%mem,rss --sort=-%cpu | head -15
printf 'NETWORK\n'
ip -s link show
ss -s
printf 'HEALTH\n'
curl -s -w '\n%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1/health
printf 'RELEASE\n'
readlink /opt/artifact-threefold/current
printf 'QUOTA\n'
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max
printf 'BANDWIDTH_HINT\n'
command -v tc >/dev/null && tc qdisc show || true
